doc_a.text: Maintenance Report: Aircraft #21 Main Fuel Pump 104 pressure dropped below 20 PSI during high-altitude climb on 2026-05-10. Emergency inspection of fuel line required.

doc_b.text: Telemetry Log 2026-05-10: P-104 fuel delivery pressure telemetry recorded sudden drop to 18 PSI at FL250 on tail #21. Corroborates fuel pump subsystem failure.

doc_a.text: Flight Navigation Debrief 2026-05-10: Pilot completed Waypoint 104 crossing on heading 270 at 10:15. Radar transponder check normal.

doc_b.text: Depot Supply Requisition 2026-05-10: Logistics order placed for Storage Bin 104 containing replacement hydraulic O-rings and gaskets.
